It is proposed that the Contract will include (non-exhaustive list – high level scope): ControlUp Performance Monitoring Software The supply of software support with licensing for the existing ESB Digital Workspace solution. Maintenance for all existing software. Management of software licences/subscriptions for all devices and software modules is required. This will not be restricted to ControlUp related products as other digital monitoring solutions will be considered.
